item.title: Musicians with Marin ties perform at Super Bowl
item.description: Alexandra Simpson took the field at Levi’s Stadium in Santa Clara on Feb. 8, Super Bowl Sunday. All her hard work and training had led up to this moment. She was ready to play — well, music, that is.

item.title: Bay FC acquires Argentina national team captain Aldana Cometti via international transfer

item.title: Prep Playoffs: Gray paces Branson to NorCal win
item.description: No. 5 seeded Branson cruised to a 64-48 victory against No. 12 Beyer (25-8) in the first round of the NorCal D-III boys basketball playoffs. NJ Gray led the Bulls with 28 points, six rebounds and six assists.

item.title: Sports Briefs: AW grad Heimbrodt earns WCC honors with Seattle
item.description: Seattle University's Will Heimbrodt, an Archie Williams High grad, was named the West Coast Conference Defensive Player of the Year.
